name: North Coast
summary: Fog shrouds North Coast along the Great Sea, where blight and murlocs shape the shore. Its cold sands lie at Tirisfal Glades' northern edge, littered with rotting marine life.

sections.title: A Blighted Shoreline
sections.body: Before the Third War, North Coast's waters and stony beaches formed Lordaeron's peaceful northern boundary. The Plague of Undeath swept across the continent, and its blight seeped down the bluffs to poison the coast. The waters grew cold and murky. Now giant sea creatures wash ashore and rot on the sand beneath the lasting coastal fog.

sections.title: The Vile Fin Shore
sections.body: With Lordaeron shattered, the Forsaken focus on Brill and the Capital City, while coastal murlocs claim the desolate sands. The Vile Fin tribe keeps huts along the surf and uses nearby shallows as spawning grounds. Ravenous murlocs gather there, including Deeb and growing tadpoles. They violently guard the tideline against surface-dwellers.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the North Coast?
faq.answer: Aggressive Vile Fin murlocs inhabit the beach, alongside their tadpoles and scavengers picking over rotting sea life washed ashore from the Great Sea.
Deeb is a murloc found along North Coast, among the shore's huts and shallows.

faq.q: Why is the coast covered in rotting carcasses?
faq.answer: The Plague of Undeath devastated Lordaeron and seeped into the coast, poisoning its shallows. Dead marine beasts wash ashore and decay on the blighted sand.

faq.q: Is the North Coast contested by any major factions?
faq.answer: Neither the Forsaken nor remnants of the Alliance actively garrison North Coast. The shore remains untamed, left largely to murlocs and sea vermin.

angles.text: Forsaken patrols follow the road through Brill. Clearing North Coast of encroaching murlocs helps keep Tirisfal Glades' northern flank relatively secure.
